benchmark_execution: After preparing baseline and inverse-candidate include snapshots whose header hashes are listed in snapshot.json, build driver.cpp against each and run with any argument to enable timings. benchmark.py records alternating 3-trial medians while holding both repository tuning locks and pinning to one CPU.
correctness_execution: Run the driver without arguments. It independently computes inverse coefficients and log coefficients via quadratic recurrences for 308 combinations; expected checksum 7082398734240149962.
source_only_followup: Blank logical lines in fps.hpp were removed after the isolated check. No C++ tokens changed in that follow-up.
reproduce_note: Copies the current local header closure into two isolated directories, reports any SHA differences from the recorded snapshot, applies only the rejected inverse patch to the candidate, and compiles/runs checks plus timing. It does not modify repository headers.
maximum_precision_note: Correctness only; records source and binary SHA-256, active assertions, closed-form result and process RSS while holding the shared tuning lock.
